title: Shiver Me Shields
subtitle: 15 tips to survive Crossbones Isle
version_note: Chapter 7 Treasure Hunters mini-season, v43.00. Based on Evolve Jake's video guide; facts checked 3 November 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book that turns a creator's fifteen Treasure Hunters tips into a guide to moving, healing, looting and surviving on Crossbones Isle, with true stories from science and history along the way.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. A clever captain hoards words as well as treasure. Pick three you've never used before and slip them into conversation this week.

chapters.title: Make Do, Me Hearties
chapters.toc: Why this season is different, and how the book works
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: No gold, no Vending Machines and a third party round every corner. Welcome to a season with no shortcuts.

chapters.title: Move Smart
chapters.toc: Overdrives, the sword hop, the Pocket Shockwave, free travel and cover
chapters.dek: Movement is rare this season, so treat it like treasure. Five ways to get around, get away and never get stuck.

chapters.title: Heal Smart
chapters.toc: Tangerines, the berry swap, Slurp cactus and barrels
chapters.dek: Healing is hard to find this season. Become a forager: speedy tangerines, a secret healing station, and barrels with a history.

chapters.title: Secret Loot
chapters.toc: Keys, the duck race, the frog statues and the waterfall cave
chapters.dek: A lost key, a race of rubber ducks, three stone frogs and a cave that opens when you dance. Curious explorers get rich.

chapters.title: Free Help
chapters.toc: Free NPCs, Rifts, and turning Sprite Dust into better weapons
chapters.dek: The gold has gone, but help is free. Hire a helper, ride a Rift, and turn your Sprite Dust into stronger weapons.

chapters.title: Squad Goals
chapters.toc: Reboot vans and cards, the Captain's route, and the ship's music
chapters.dek: Never give up on a teammate. Reboot vans, cards that come back on their own, a Captain at the wheel, and a song that sailed from Sydney.

chapters.toc: Quiz: from Cabin Boy to Captain
